met_analysis:
The Low Pressure area over Southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood has become less marked. However, the associated cyclonic circulation persists and now extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Bikaner, Guna, Daltonganj, Bankura thence eastwards towards Manipur.
The trough from southwest Rajasthan to northeast Bihar across cyclonic circulation over Southwest Rajasthan & neighbourhood, northern parts of Madhya Pradesh, southeast Uttar Pradesh and extends upto 4.5 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height persists.
The offshore trough at mean sea level from South Gujarat to Kerala persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Assam & neighbourhood extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southeast Himachal Pradesh & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Himachal Pradesh & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level has moved away.
The upper air cyclonic circulation lies over North Tamilnadu & neighbourhood and extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
